people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, ‘As your god, Dan, lives;’ and, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives;’ they will fall, and never rise up again.”
translations.bsb: Those who swear by the guilt of Samaria and say, ‘As surely as your god lives, O Dan,’ or, ‘As surely as the way of Beersheba lives’— they will fall, never to rise again.”
translations.kjv: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beersheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise up
translations.asv: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, As thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, As the way of Beer-sheba liveth; they shall fall, and never rise up again.
